Hi John 

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: customer-facing document summarization (high QPS, strict latency).
- Data classification: customer PII may be included in prompts; FinTechCo needs assurances around retention and access controls.
- SLOs: 95th percentile latency target ~300ms for short requests; predictable throughput during batch windows.

I've attached our SOC 2 Type II packet and a short data flow diagram for your security team to review. Key asks from your side: an expected timeline for the security review and any specific artifacts you need (pen test, encryption details, CSP changes).

Attachments: FinTechCo_SOC2_Packet_v3.pdf (SOC 2 Type II packet), redwood_data_flow_diagram.png
Links: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/soc2-packet
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FT-4832

Proposed next steps:
1) Security review  please loop in your security lead and confirm whether a 2-week or 4-week review is likely.
2) If helpful, we can do a 30-min walkthrough with our security engineer (Dev) next week.
3) Pricing/commit discussion once security sign-off looks feasible.

Thanks  I know these reviews are busy, so if priority/timing has shifted please let me know and I can adjust cadence.

Marissa 

Apologies for the slow reply  security got pulled onto another incident this week. Sara says they've started the review but have a couple quick clarifying questions before we schedule a walkthrough:

1) Data retention: do you retain raw prompts or embeddings for more than 30 days by default?
2) Encryption: can you confirm customer-managed KMS support for our dedicated deployment?
3) Data access: are there role-based access controls and audit logs available for staff accesses?

If you can send short answers to the three items above, Sara will determine whether a walkthrough is required or if they can proceed asynchronously.

Thanks  we're still interested, just need those items to move forward.

John

John / Sara 

Thanks  answers below to help unblock your team quickly: 

1) Data retention: By default, we do not persist raw prompts or embeddings beyond 30 days for hosted customers; for Dedicated/Private deployments customers can configure retention policies or opt out of logs entirely.

2) Encryption / KMS: We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and Dedicated instances (we'll share an integration checklist). For hosted accounts we offer envelope encryption and HSM-backed KMS for keys managed by Redwood; customer-managed keys are available on request for enterprise contracts.

3) Data access / audit logs: RBAC is supported across roles in the Console (admins, operators, read-only). Audit logs for configuration changes and staff access are captured and can be exported; we can provide a sample audit extract for review.

I've attached the data flow diagram again and a one-pager with KMS integration notes. If those answers look good, happy to set up a 30-minute walkthrough with Dev this week  available 3pm PT Thursday or 10am PT Friday.

Best,
Marissa
